description: This file defines the `Polymer.PaperRippleBehavior`, a Polymer behavior that adds ripple effect functionality to custom elements, including properties, methods for managing ripples, and event handlers.

methods.name: _buttonStateChanged
methods.description: Ensures a `<paper-ripple>` element is available when the element is focused.

methods.name: _downHandler
methods.description: Handles the pointer down event; in addition to IronButtonState handling, ensures ripple on pressed.

methods.name: ensureRipple
methods.description: Ensures that a `<paper-ripple>` element exists; creates it on demand.

methods.name: getRipple
methods.description: Returns the `<paper-ripple>` element, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: hasRipple
methods.description: Checks whether a ripple effect currently exists.

methods.name: _createRipple
methods.description: Creates a new `<paper-ripple>` element; can be overridden for customization.

methods.name: _noinkChanged
methods.description: Observer that updates the ripple's 'noink' property when the 'noink' property changes.
